topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the opening framing and goals for the lecture on the initiation and resolution of immune responses.

topics.label: Pattern recognition and innate receptor signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system detects infections and cellular damage using pattern recognition receptors and downstream signaling complexes.

topics.label: Inflammatory leukocyte trafficking and systemic outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how activated sentinel cells direct immune cell recruitment to tissues and lymph nodes and how uncontrolled responses can cause severe systemic pathology.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic adaptations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the mechanisms that terminate inflammation, repair injured tissue, and establish persistent containment structures when infections cannot be cleared.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the closing framing for the session and previews the subject of the next lecture.
